title: A Practical Approach to Performance Interventions and Analysis: 50 Models for Building a High-Performance Culture
description: Imagine your best possible organization: a place where people strive for continuous improvement, communicate clearly and honestly, freely share information, respect their colleagues and leaders, make a difference -- and achieve truly extraordinary levels of performance, even in tough times. Using this book’s powerful Work/Life Approach, you can build that organization. World-renowned performance consultants Dr. Gene Fusch and Richard Gillespie offer a step-by-step blueprint for developing a true performance culture, where people bring a relentless focus and selfless collaboration to bear on the organization’s most fundamental goals. A Practical Approach to Performance Interventions and Analysis walks through every step of the process: analyzing business problems, identifying performance gaps, selecting the best interventions, measuring results, and more. You’ll learn how to integrate your organization’s goals with the beliefs and needs of your people; foster unity without conformity, and diversity without division; how to overcome the fear and distrust that makes organizations dysfunctional; and how to build an organization where everyone really takes ownership of their “fraction of the action.” Along the way, they present 50 dynamic models that tightly connect theory to real-world business practice, are ROI-driven, are fully measurable, and can be utilized by all leaders and practitioners in HR, organizational development, and training. With their guidance, you can choose and execute the performance initiatives that deliver the greatest positive impact on culture, business metrics, and the lives of all your people.
translatedDescription: Imagínese su mejor organización posible: un lugar donde la gente se esfuerza por una mejora continua, comunicarse con claridad y honestidad, compartir información libremente, respetar a sus colegas y líderes, hacer una diferencia - y alcanzar niveles de rendimiento realmente extraordinarios, incluso en tiempos difíciles. Usando el poderoso Work/Life Approach de este libro, puedes construir esa organización. El Dr. Gene Fusch y Richard Gillespie, consultores de renombre mundial, ofrecen un plan paso a paso para desarrollar una verdadera cultura de rendimiento, donde las personas aportan un enfoque implacable y una colaboración desinteresada para cumplir con los objetivos más fundamentales de la organización. Un enfoque práctico para las intervenciones y análisis de rendimiento recorre cada paso del proceso: analizar los problemas de negocio, identificar las brechas de rendimiento, seleccionar las mejores intervenciones, medir resultados y más. title: Too Big to Ignore
description: Residents in Boston, Massachusetts are automatically reporting potholes and road hazards via their smartphones. Progressive Insurance tracks real-time customer driving patterns and uses that information to offer rates truly commensurate with individual safety. Google accurately predicts local flu outbreaks based upon thousands of user search queries. Amazon provides remarkably insightful, relevant, and timely product recommendations to its hundreds of millions of customers. Quantcast lets companies target precise audiences and key demographics throughout the Web. NASA runs contests via gamification site TopCoder, awarding prizes to those with the most innovative and cost-effective solutions to its problems. Explorys offers penetrating and previously unknown insights into healthcare behavior.How do these organizations and municipalities do it? Technology is certainly a big part, but in each case the answer lies deeper than that. Individuals at these organizations have realized that they don't have to be Nate Silver to reap massive benefits from today's new and emerging types of data. And each of these organizations has embraced Big Data, allowing them to make astute and otherwise impossible observations, actions, and predictions.It's time to start thinking big.In Too Big to Ignore, recognized technology expert and award-winning author Phil Simon explores an unassailably important trend: Big Data, the massive amounts, new types, and multifaceted sources of information streaming at us faster than ever. Never before have we seen data with the volume, velocity, and variety of today. Big Data is no temporary blip of fad. In fact, it is only going to intensify in the coming years, and its ramifications for the future of business are impossible to overstate.Too Big to Ignore explains why Big Data is a big deal. Simon provides commonsense, jargon-free advice for people and organizations looking to understand and leverage Big Data. Rife with case studies, examples, analysis, and quotes from real-world Big Data practitioners, the book is required reading for chief executives, company owners, industry leaders, and business professionals.

Google predice con precisión brotes de gripe local basados en miles de consultas de búsqueda de usuarios. Amazon proporciona recomendaciones de productos notablemente perspicaces, relevantes y oportunas a sus cientos de millones de clientes. Quantcast permite que las empresas dirijan audiencias precisas y demografías clave en toda la Web. NASA ejecuta concursos a través del sitio de gamificación TopCoder, premiando a aquellos con las soluciones más innovadoras y rentables a sus problemas. Explorys ofrece información penetrante y desconocida sobre el comportamiento sanitario. ¿Cómo lo hacen estas organizaciones y municipios? La tecnología es sin duda una gran parte, pero en cada caso la respuesta es más profunda que eso. Los individuos de estas organizaciones se han dado cuenta de que no tienen que ser Nate Silver para obtener beneficios masivos de los nuevos y emergentes tipos de datos de hoy. Y cada una de estas organizaciones ha adoptado Big Data, permitiéndoles hacer observaciones, acciones y predicciones astutas y de otra manera imposibles. Es hora de empezar a pensar en grande. En Too Big to Ignore, reconocido experto en tecnología y galardonado autor Phil Simon explora una tendencia increíblemente importante: Big Data, las cantidades masivas, los nuevos tipos y las fuentes multifacéticas de información que nos transmiten más rápido que nunca. Nunca antes hemos visto datos con el volumen, velocidad y variedad de hoy. Big Data no es un blip temporal de moda. title: Dispatches from Blogistan: A Travel Guide for the Modern Blogger
description: The term "blog" wasn't coined until 1999 and yet by 2004, it had become Merriam-Webster's Word of the Year. Globally, the number of blogs is doubling every six months, with more than 50 million blogs online today. Here to offer a unique overview of the emerging phenomenon that even armchair observers will find curiosity-satisfying is Dispatches from Blogistan: A Travel Guide for the Modern Blogger. Filled with practical, easy-to-implement advice for making blogging more enjoyable, useful, and profitable, this book covers everything from blogging and how it fits into the history of journalism to practical tips for planning and managing a blog, attracting and retaining an active readership. Written by noted technology journalist and interactive media veteran Suzanne Stefanac, the book features a fresh and succinct approach; quotes and commentary from noted and celebrity bloggers (author/futurist Bruce Sterling, NPR commentator Farai Chideya, Craig Newmark of craigslist.com, and Cory Doctorow, Boing Boing editor and science fiction author, among others); an accompanying blog site (dispatchesfromblogistan.com); and more. Stefanac explores issues of trust, influence, privacy, discovery, and the power of collaborative discourse, making this is a blog book like no other!

Stefanac explora temas de confianza, influencia, privacidad, descubrimiento y el poder del discurso colaborativo, haciendo de este es un libro de blog como ningún otro!

title: Play Readings
description: Play Readings: A Complete Guide for Theatre Practitioners demystifies the standards and protocols of a play reading, demonstrating how to create effective and evocative readings for those new to or inexperienced with the genre. It examines all of the essential considerations involved in readings, including the use of the venue, pre-reading preparations, playwright/director communication, editing/adapting stage directions, casting, using the limited rehearsal time effectively, simple "staging" suggestions, working with actors, handling complex stage directions, talkbacks, and limiting the use of props, costumes, and music. A variety of readings are covered, including readings of musicals, operas, and period plays, for comprehensive coverage of this increasingly prevalent production form.

Examina todas las consideraciones esenciales involucradas en las lecturas, incluyendo el uso del lugar, preparaciones previas, comunicación de playwright/director, edición/adaptación de direcciones de escenarios, casting, utilizando el tiempo de ensayo limitado de manera efectiva, simples sugerencias de "estancia", trabajando con actores, manejando complejas direcciones de escenario, charlas y limitando el uso de props, trajes y música. Se cubre una variedad de lecturas, incluyendo lecturas de musicales, óperas y juegos de época, para una cobertura integral de esta forma de producción cada vez más frecuente.

title: The Thong Principle
description:
The Thong Principle has little to do with beachwear and everything to do with effective communication. It’s about ensuring messages are successful for the sender – and the receiver.

The book delves into the elements that comprise successful communications – conciseness, clarity, concreteness, and much more. It also puts those elements into context. Communications that miss the mark confuse and annoy. They fail to deliver their message. They damage our credibility and erode goodwill.

The Thong Principle overflows with real-world examples to help us understand why we fail to get our messages across as intended.

Then it explains how we can anticipate, identify, and correct errors and oversights. This is both at the highest level – including building and maintaining trust – and down in the weeds where even one word makes a difference.

The Thong Principle will draw you in and keep you reading with:

Examples
Exercises
Information that resonates.

It’s also funny. Laughter and learning are wonderful partners.
translatedDescription:
El Principio Thong tiene poco que ver con el traje de playa y todo lo que hay que hacer con una comunicación efectiva. Se trata de asegurar que los mensajes sean exitosos para el remitente – y el receptor.

El libro profundiza en los elementos que componen comunicaciones exitosas: conciseness, claridad, concreto y mucho más. También pone esos elementos en contexto. Comunicaciones que pierden la marca confusa y molesta. No entregan su mensaje. Ellos dañan nuestra credibilidad y erosionan la buena voluntad.

El Principio Thong se desborda con ejemplos del mundo real para ayudarnos a entender por qué no logramos que nuestros mensajes se dirijan como se pretendía.

Luego explica cómo podemos anticipar, identificar y corregir errores y controles. Esto es tanto en el nivel más alto – incluyendo construir y mantener la confianza – y abajo en las malas hierbas donde incluso una palabra marca la diferencia.

El Principio Thong te dibujará y te mantendrá leyendo con:

Ejemplos
Ejercicios
Información que resuena.

También es gracioso. La risa y el aprendizaje son socios maravillosos.

title: Optical CDMA Networks: Principles, Analysis and Applications
description:
This book focuses heavily on the principles, analysis and applications of code-division multiple-access (CDMA) techniques in optical communication systems and networks.

In this book, the authors intimately discuss modern optical networks and their applications in current and emerging communication technologies, evaluating the quality, speed and number of supported services. In particular, principles and fundamentals of optical CDMA techniques from beginner to advanced levels are heavily covered. Furthermore, the authors concentrate on methods and techniques of various encoding and decoding schemes and their structures, as well as analysis of optical CDMA systems with various transceiver models including advanced multi-level incoherent and coherent modulations with the architecture of access/aggregation networks in mind. Moreover, authors examine intriguing topics of optical CDMA networking, compatibility with IP networks, and implementation of optical multi-rate multi-service CDMA networks.

Key features:

Expanded coverage of optical CDMA networks, starts from principles and fundamentals

Comprehensive mathematical modelling and analysis from signal to system levels

Addresses the applications of modern optical networking in the current and emerging communication technologies

Greater focus on advanced optical multi-level incoherent and coherent modulations, spreading codes, and transceiver designs

Detailed hardware specifications, system-level block diagrams, and network nodes' functionalities

This book appeals to researchers, practicing engineers, and advanced students. It is a practical resource for readers with an interest in optical communications and networks.
translatedDescription:
Este libro se centra fuertemente en los principios, análisis y aplicaciones de las técnicas de acceso múltiple (CDMA) de código-división en sistemas y redes de comunicación óptica.

En este libro, los autores discuten íntimamente las redes ópticas modernas y sus aplicaciones en tecnologías de comunicación actuales y emergentes, evaluando la calidad, la velocidad y el número de servicios apoyados. En particular, los principios y fundamentos de las técnicas ópticas de MDL desde niveles principiantes hasta avanzados están muy cubiertos. Además, los autores se concentran en métodos y técnicas de diversos esquemas de codificación y decodificación y sus estructuras, así como en el análisis de sistemas ópticos de CDMA con diversos modelos transceptores, incluyendo modulaciones avanzadas de múltiples niveles y coherentes con la arquitectura de redes de acceso/agregación en mente. Además, los autores examinan temas intrigantes de redes ópticas de CDMA, compatibilidad con redes IP y aplicación de redes ópticas de CDMA multiservicio.

Características clave:

Ampliación de la cobertura de redes ópticas CDMA, partiendo de principios y fundamentos

Modelización matemática integral y análisis desde niveles de señal a sistema

Aborda las aplicaciones de las redes ópticas modernas en las tecnologías de comunicación actuales y emergentes

Mayor enfoque en modulaciones avanzadas ópticas multinivel, coherentes, códigos de difusión y diseños transceptores

Especificaciones detalladas de hardware, diagramas de bloques a nivel de sistema y funcionalidades de nodos de red

Este libro atrae a investigadores, ingenieros practicantes y estudiantes avanzados. Es un recurso práctico para los lectores con interés en comunicaciones y redes ópticas.

Organized thematically for use both as a full introduction to the field or an encyclopedic reference

Draws on original essays from leading interdisciplinary scholars

Features the most up-to-date and cutting edge research in the interdisciplinary fields of philosophy, technology, and their broader intellectual environments

title: Locksport

Welcome to the world of locksport, the sport of defeating locks. Whether you’re new to the challenge of lockpicking or aiming for championship gold, this book serves as your definitive guide, packed with practical advice from a team of experts.

How various locks work and how to maintain and disassemble practice locks
What makes some locks more secure than others
The laws, competitions, and communities that make up the world of locksport

MASTER YOUR CRAFT WITH HANDS-ON TECHNIQUES

How to pick pin tumblers and lever locks, make impressions or craft a working key from a blank, and manipulate open combination safe locks
How to work with picks, rakes, tension wrenches, files, magnification tools, safe-lock graphs, and depth-measuring instruments
The intricacies of security pins, wards, dimple locks, keyways, and antique locks

GAIN THE COMPETITIVE EDGE WITH COMPETITION INSIGHTS

The ins and outs of competition setup and tools and how to host your own competitions
Expert strategies for managing your nerves and gathering lock intel
What it’s like to participate in timed head-to-head competitions, PicTacToe™, escape challenges, and other lockpicking contests

From mastering your first padlock to conquering a competition, Locksport will show you how to take your skills to the next level—and have endless fun doing it.

Las complejidades de los pines de seguridad, las verrugas, las cerraduras extensivas, las teclas y las cerraduras antiguas

title: Tomcat: The Definitive Guide, 2nd Edition
description:
It takes a book as versatile as its subject to cover Apache Tomcat, the popular open source Servlet and JSP container and high performance web server. Tomcat: The Definitive Guide is a valuable reference for administrators and webmasters, a useful guide for programmers who want to use Tomcat as their web application server during development or in production, and an excellent introduction for anyone interested in Tomcat. Updated for the latest version of Tomcat, this new edition offers a complete guide to installing, configuring, maintaining and securing this servlet container. In fact, with such a wealth of new information, this is essentially a new book rather than a simple revision. You will find details for using Tomcat on all major platforms, including Windows, Linux, OS X, Solaris, and FreeBSD, along with specifics on Tomcat configuration files, and step-by-step advice for deploying and running web applications. This book offers complete information for:

Installation and startup procedures

Configuring Tomcat-including realms, roles, users, servlet sessions, and JNDI resources including JDBC DataSources

Deploying web applications-individual servlets and JSP pages, and web application archive files

Tuning Tomcat to measure and improve performance

Integrating Tomcat with Apache Web Server

Securing Tomcat to keep online thugs at bay

Tomcat configuration files-server.xml and web.xml, and more

Debugging and Troubleshooting-diagnosing problems with Tomcat or a web application

Compiling your own Tomcat, rather than using the pre-built release

Running two or more Tomcat servlet containers in parallel

This book also offers an overview of the Tomcat open source project's community resources, including docs, mailing lists, and more. Community interest fueled a strong demand for a Tomcat guide from O'Reilly. The result clearly exceeds expectations.

title: No Sweat
description:
Selected as the #1 book in diet/exercise for 2015 by USA Best Book Awards.

We start out with the best intentions. We're going to exercise more and get in shape! Then five days a week at the gym turns into two... then becomes none. We hit the snooze button and skip the morning run.

We really do want to be healthy and fit, but we're over whelmed and overextended—and exercise feels like another chore to complete. Is it any wonder we don't stick with it? Behavior expert Michelle Segar has devoted her career to the science of motivation. In No Sweat, she reveals that while "better health" or "weight loss" sound like strong incentives, human beings are hardwired to choose immediate gratification over delayed benefits. In other words, we're not going to exercise unless it makes us happy right now.

So what's the solution? To achieve lasting fitness, we have to change our minds—before we can change our bodies. In No Sweat, Segar shows us how. Translating twenty years of research on exercise and motivation into a simple four-point program, she helps readers broaden their definition of exercise, find pleasure in physical activity, and discover realistic ways to fit it into their lives. Activities we enjoy, we repeat—making this evidence-based system more sustainable in the long run than a regimen of intense workouts. Even if we don't sweat, we really benefit.

The success of the clients Segar has coached testifies to the power of her program. Their stories punctuate the book, entertaining and emboldening readers to break the cycle of exercise failure once and for all. Complete with worksheets, tips, and techniques, getting in shape has never been so easy—or so much fun.

Instructors can find the No Sweat Teaching and Discussion Guideon Michelle Segar’s Website: www.michellesegar.com/get-resources/
translatedDescription:
Seleccionado como el #1 libro en dieta/ejercicio para 2015 por USA Best Book Awards.

Empezamos con las mejores intenciones. ¡Vamos a ejercitar más y ponernos en forma! Luego cinco días a la semana en el gimnasio se convierte en dos... entonces no se convierte en ninguno. Golpeamos el botón de snooze y saltamos la carrera de la mañana.

Realmente queremos estar sanos y aptos, pero hemos terminado de golpear y sobreextender, y el ejercicio se siente como otra tarea para completar. ¿Es extraño que no nos quedemos con él? La experta en comportamiento, Michelle Segar, ha dedicado su carrera a la ciencia de la motivación. En No Sweat, revela que aunque la "mejor salud" o la "pérdida del peso" suenan como fuertes incentivos, los seres humanos son duros para elegir la gratificación inmediata sobre beneficios retardados. En otras palabras, no vamos a hacer ejercicio a menos que nos haga felices ahora mismo.

¿Cuál es la solución? Para lograr una aptitud duradera, tenemos que cambiar nuestras mentes antes de que podamos cambiar nuestros cuerpos. En No Sweat, Segar nos muestra cómo. Traducir veinte años de investigación sobre el ejercicio y la motivación en un simple programa de cuatro puntos, ayuda a los lectores a ampliar su definición de ejercicio, encontrar placer en la actividad física y descubrir formas realistas de encajar en sus vidas. Actividades que disfrutamos, repetimos, haciendo que este sistema basado en evidencia sea más sostenible a largo plazo que un régimen de intensos entrenamientos. Incluso si no sudamos, realmente nos beneficiamos.

El éxito de los clientes Segar ha entrenado atestigua el poder de su programa. Sus historias puntuan el libro, entretenidos y ensanchadores lectores para romper el ciclo de fracaso del ejercicio de una vez por todas. Completo con hojas de trabajo, consejos y técnicas, ponerse en forma nunca ha sido tan fácil—o tan divertido.

Los instructores pueden encontrar el sitio web de No Sweat Teaching and Discussion Guideon Michelle Segar: www.michellesegar.com/get-resources/

title: Technology Trends for 2024
description: For decades, the tech industry hummed along on a predictable five-year disruption cycle. Microservices, cloud, Agile--each marked a turning point, but the pace felt manageable. Then came 2023. One explosive AI breakthrough, ChatGPT, changed all of that. In this exclusive new report, Mike Loukides delves deep into O'Reilly's learning platform data to unveil the hidden patterns of this shift. Forget the hype and trend reports; this data shows where real software developers are heading, the skills they're acquiring, and the technologies poised to reshape the entire landscape. And it isn't just ChatGPT making waves. It's about the AI revolution that's already begun and how you can stay ahead of the curve. Get a glimpse into the software development future that's unfolding before our eyes.

En este nuevo informe exclusivo, Mike Loukides profundiza en los datos de la plataforma de aprendizaje de O'Reilly para revelar los patrones ocultos de este cambio. Olvídate de los informes de hipócritas y tendencias; estos datos muestran a dónde se dirigen los desarrolladores de software real, las habilidades que están adquiriendo, y las tecnologías están preparadas para remodelar todo el paisaje. Y no es sólo ChatGPT haciendo olas. Se trata de la revolución de la AI que ya ha comenzado y de cómo puedes seguir adelante con la curva. Obtenga un vistazo al futuro de desarrollo del software que se está desarrollando ante nuestros ojos.

title: Illustrated Guide to Astronomical Wonders
description:
With the advent of inexpensive, high-power telescopes priced atunder $250, amateur astronomy is now within the reach of anyone,and this is the ideal book to get you started. The IllustratedGuide to Astronomical Wonders offers you a guide to theequipment you need, and shows you how and where to find hundreds ofspectacular objects in the deep sky -- double and multiple stars aswell as spectacular star clusters, nebulae, and galaxies.You get a solid grounding in the fundamental concepts andterminology of astronomy, and specific advice about choosing,buying, using, and maintaining the equipment required forobserving. The Illustrated Guide to Astronomical Wondersis designed to be used in the field under the special red-coloredlighting used by astronomers, and includes recommended observingtargets for beginners and intermediate observers alike. You getdetailed start charts and specific information about the bestcelestial objects.The objects in this book were chosen to help you meet therequirements for several lists of objects compiled by TheAstronomical League (http://www.astroleague.org) orthe Royal Astronomical Society of Canada (http://www.rasc.ca): Messier Club.

Binocular Messier Club

Urban Observing Club

Deep Sky Binocular Club

Double Star Club

RASC Finest NGC List

Completing the list for a particular observing club entitles anyonewho is a member of the Astronomical League or RASC to an award,which includes a certificate and, in some cases, a lapel pin.This book is perfect for amateur astronomers, students, teachers,or anyone who is ready to dive into this rewarding hobby. Whoknows? You might even find a new object, like amateur astronomerJay McNeil. On a clear cold night in January 2004, he spotted apreviously undiscovered celestial object near Orion, now calledMcNeil's Nebula. Discover what awaits you in the night sky with theIllustrated Guide to Astronomical Wonders.

title: The Geek Atlas
description:
The history of science is all around us, if you know where to look. With this unique traveler's guide, you'll learn about 128 destinations around the world where discoveries in science, mathematics, or technology occurred or is happening now. Travel to Munich to see the world's largest science museum, watch Foucault's pendulum swinging in Paris, ponder a descendant of Newton's apple tree at Trinity College, Cambridge, and more.Each site in The Geek Atlas focuses on discoveries or inventions, and includes information about the people and the science behind them. Full of interesting photos and illustrations, the book is organized geographically by country (by state within the U.S.), complete with latitudes and longitudes for GPS devices. Destinations include:

Bletchley Park in the UK, where the Enigma code was broken
The Alan Turing Memorial in Manchester, England
The Horn Antenna in New Jersey, where the Big Bang theory was confirmed
The National Cryptologic Museum in Fort Meade, Maryland
The Trinity Test Site in New Mexico, where the first atomic bomb was exploded
The Joint Genome Institute in Walnut Creek, California

You won't find tedious, third-rate museums, or a tacky plaque stuck to a wall stating that "Professor X slept here." Every site in this book has real scientific, mathematical, or technological interest -- places guaranteed to make every geek's heart pound a little faster. Plan a trip with The Geek Atlas and make your own discoveries along the way.

Con esta guía única de viajero, usted aprenderá sobre 128 destinos alrededor del mundo donde se produjeron descubrimientos en ciencia, matemáticas o tecnología o está sucediendo ahora. Viaja a Múnich para ver el museo científico más grande del mundo, observa el péndulo de Foucault oscilando en París, ponderar un descendiente del manzano de Newton en Trinity College, Cambridge, y más. Cada sitio de The Geek Atlas se centra en descubrimientos o invenciones, e incluye información sobre la gente y la ciencia detrás de ellos. Lleno de interesantes fotos e ilustraciones, el libro se organiza geográficamente por país (por estado dentro de Estados Unidos), con latitudes y longitudes para dispositivos GPS. Los destinos incluyen:

Bletchley Park en el Reino Unido, donde se rompió el código Enigma
The Alan Turing Memorial in Manchester, England
La Antena de Cuerno en Nueva Jersey, donde se confirmó la teoría del Big Bang
Museo Nacional Cryptologic en Fort Meade, Maryland
The Trinity Test Site in New Mexico, where the first atomic bomb was exploded
The Joint Genome Institute in Walnut Creek, California

No encontrarás tediosos museos de tercera clase, ni una placa atorada a una pared diciendo que "el profesor X durmió aquí". Cada sitio en este libro tiene un interés científico, matemático o tecnológico real -- lugares garantizados para hacer la libra de corazón de cada geek un poco más rápido. Planifique un viaje con The Geek Atlas y haga sus propios descubrimientos en el camino.

title: Alan Turing and his Contemporaries
description: Secret wartime projects in areas such as code-breaking, radar and ballistics produced a wealth of ideas and technologies that kick-started the development of digital computers. This is the story of the people and projects that flourished in the post-war period. Their influence is still discernable deep down within today’s hardware and software.
translatedDescription: Los proyectos secretos de tiempos de guerra en áreas como la ruptura de códigos, el radar y la balística produjeron una gran cantidad de ideas y tecnologías que iniciaron el desarrollo de computadoras digitales. Esta es la historia del pueblo y los proyectos que florecieron en la posguerra. Su influencia todavía es discernible en profundidad dentro del hardware y software de hoy.

title: Apache Tomcat 7 Essentials
description:
Apache Tomcat 7 Essentials is your guide to mastering the setup, configuration, and maintenance of Apache Tomcat version 7. This book leads you through a structured path, from initial installation to advanced performance tuning, ensuring you have the skills to confidently deploy and manage Tomcat servers in various environments.

What this Book will help me do

Learn step-by-step installation of Apache Tomcat 7 on Windows and Linux platforms.
Gain the expertise to configure enterprise application setups with clustering and load balancing.
Master the art of performance tuning and issue diagnostics for Tomcat servers.
Understand migration and upgrade procedures from earlier Tomcat versions to version 7.
Learn best practices for high availability and optimization in production environments.

Author(s)

Tanuj Khare brings his extensive experience in web hosting and server administration to offer a clear and practical guide to Tomcat 7. His expertise ensures the book is thorough and accessible, balancing theory with practical insights. As an educator and practitioner, he prioritizes equipping readers with actionable knowledge applicable to real-world scenarios.

Who is it for?

This book is tailored for J2EE administrators, migration administrators, and technical architects responsible for Tomcat-based applications. The content assumes a basic understanding of application servers but supports progress from beginner to advanced technical proficiency. title: Tomcat: The Definitive Guide

Powerful and flexible, it can be used as a stand-alone web server or in conjunction with another server, like Apache or IIS, to run servlets or JSPs. But mastery of Tomcat is not easy: because it's as complex as it is complete. Tomcat: The Definitive Guide answers vexing questions that users, administrators, and developers alike have been asking. The authors show how directories are laid out, cover the initial setup, and describe how to set the environment variables and modify the configuration files, concluding with common errors, problems, and solutions. In subsequent chapters, they cover:

title: Visitor Management
description:
'Visitor Management' is an innovative collection of case studies taken from cultural World Heritage Sites. Using examples from the world's most significant archaeological and architectural legacies this book identifies the problems involved with site management.

Cultural World Heritage Sites are extremely attractive to contemporary visitors. This poses many problems for site management, notably the need to preserve a delicate balance between interpretation, conservation and the provision of visitor facilities.

This contributed title takes examples from a range of UNESCO World Heritage Sites and shows models of good practice looking at the functions of the different organizations involved and the range of variation among sites. The contributors have international expertise and draw on first-hand knowledge at a practical level.

'Visitor Management: Case studies from World Heritage Sites' is ideal for practitioners and students involved in heritage management and conservation management. Undergraduate and postgraduate students in tourism, leisure and hospitality will also find this book an invaluable read.

Myra Shackley is Professor of Culture Resource Management and Head of the Centre for Tourism and Visitor Management at Nottingham Trent University. Her research interests lie in the management of cultural and wildlife tourism, particularly in relation to Protected Areas and World Heritage Sites. She has published eleven previous books, of which the last was 'Wildlife Tourism' (International Thompson Business Press, 1996) and has extensive research and consultancy interests within the field of visitor management.

Cultural World Heritage Sites son extremadamente atractivos para los visitantes contemporáneos. Esto plantea muchos problemas para la gestión de sitios, en particular la necesidad de preservar un delicado equilibrio entre la interpretación, la conservación y la provisión de instalaciones para visitantes.

title: The Cable and Telecommunications Professionals' Reference, 3rd Edition
description: Volume 2 of TERB 3ed covers the convergence of telephony and data transport, including wireless networks. Now that data is becoming the predominant source of traffic more efficient multiplexing schemes and more flexible control methods are needed in the transport network, such as giving the customer the ability to call for bandwidth on demand. With the development of control methods for switched data services it is now recognised that improved ways to control the transport network are possible and standards initiatives are taking place to establish and improve the network control layer. Detailed explanation of propagation in wireless and optical fibre systems requires a substantial amount of mathematics, also covered in this volume. For each of the math chapters there is an explanation of why the mathematics is important, where it is applied and references to other chapters.

Con el desarrollo de métodos de control para los servicios de datos conmutados se reconoce ahora que se pueden mejorar las formas de controlar la red de transporte y se están llevando a cabo iniciativas de normas para establecer y mejorar la capa de control de la red. title: Reverse Innovation in Health Care
description:
Health-Care Solutions from a Distant Shore

Health care in the United States and other nations is on a collision course with patient needs and economic reality. For more than a decade, leading thinkers, including Michael Porter and Clayton Christensen, have argued passionately for value-based health-care reform: replacing delivery based on volume and fee-for-service with competition based on value, as measured by patient outcomes per dollar spent.

Though still a pipe dream here in the United States, this kind of value-based competition is already a reality--in India. Facing a giant population of poor, underserved people and a severe shortage of skills and capacity, some resourceful private enterprises have found a way to deliver high-quality health care, at ultra-low prices, to all patients who need it. This book shows how the innovations developed by these Indian exemplars are already being practiced by some far-sighted US providers--reversing the typical flow of innovation in the world.

Govindarajan and Ramamurti, experts in the phenomenon of reverse innovation, reveal four pathways being used by health-care organizations in the United States to apply Indian-style principles to attack the exorbitant costs, uneven quality, and incomplete access to health care. With rich stories and detailed accounts of medical professionals who are putting these ideas into practice, this book shows how value-based delivery can be made to work in the United States. This "bottom-up" change doesn't require a grand plan out of Washington, DC, agreement between entrenched political parties, or coordination among all players in the health-care system. It needs entrepreneurs with innovative ideas about delivering value to patients. Reverse innovation has worked in other industries. We need it now in health care.
translatedDescription:
Soluciones de cuidado de la salud de un Shore distante

La atención sanitaria en Estados Unidos y otras naciones está en un curso de colisión con necesidades de pacientes y realidad económica. Durante más de una década, los principales pensadores, incluyendo a Michael Porter y Clayton Christensen, han argumentado apasionadamente por la reforma de la salud basada en el valor: reemplazar la entrega basada en el volumen y la tasa por servicio con la competencia basada en el valor, medida por los resultados del paciente por dólar gastado.

Aunque todavía un sueño de tuberías aquí en los Estados Unidos, este tipo de competencia basada en el valor ya es una realidad - en la India. Enfrentándose a una población gigante de personas pobres y subsidiadas y a una grave escasez de habilidades y capacidad, algunas empresas privadas de recursos han encontrado la manera de ofrecer atención médica de alta calidad, a precios ultrabajos, a todos los pacientes que lo necesitan. Este libro muestra cómo las innovaciones desarrolladas por estos ejemplares indios ya están siendo practicadas por algunos proveedores de Estados Unidos de vista muy distantes, revirtiendo el flujo típico de la innovación en el mundo.

Govindarajan y Ramamurti, expertos en el fenómeno de la innovación inversa, revelan cuatro caminos que utilizan las organizaciones de salud en los Estados Unidos para aplicar principios de estilo indio para atacar los costos exorbitantes, la calidad desigual y el acceso incompleto a la atención de la salud. Con historias ricas y cuentas detalladas de profesionales médicos que están poniendo en práctica estas ideas, este libro muestra cómo se puede hacer una entrega basada en el valor para trabajar en los Estados Unidos. Este cambio "abajo" no requiere un gran plan fuera de Washington, DC, acuerdo entre partidos políticos arraigados, o coordinación entre todos los actores del sistema de salud. Necesita emprendedores con ideas innovadoras sobre la entrega de valor a los pacientes. La innovación inversa ha trabajado en otras industrias. Lo necesitamos ahora en atención médica.

title: ARCHIVED: Pooled JVM in CICS Transaction Server V3
description:
NOTE: This book contains information about technologies that have been superseded and it is retained for historical purposes only.

IBM CICS Transaction Server (CICS TS) has supported the deployment of Java applications since the 1990’s. In CICS TS V1.3 (1999), IBM introduced the 'Pooled JVM' style of JVM infrastructure within CICS TS. This infrastructure was designed to be similar in nature to that which a CICS application developer for a language such as COBOL would be used to. It brought the benefits of the new Java language to CICS TS, without a dramatic change to the way CICS users thought of core concepts such as re-entrancy and isolation.

As enterprise usage of Java evolved it began to make more and more use of multi-threaded environments where isolation was not a desired characteristic. Additionally, technologies such as OSGi (Open Service Gateway Initiative) evolved to overcome some of the original disadvantages of applying Java to an enterprise environment. As such, the limitations of the 'Pooled JVM' approach began to outweigh the benefits.

In CICS TS V4.1 (2009), IBM introduced the new 'JVM server' infrastructure in CICS TS as a replacement to the 'Pooled JVM' approach. This 'JVM server' infrastructure provides a much more standard Java environment that makes the writing and porting of Java applications for CICS TS much simpler.

In CICS TS V5.1 (2012), support for the old 'Pooled JVM' infrastructure was removed. While there is a relatively simple migration path from 'Pooled JVM' to 'JVM server', applications should no longer be written to the 'Pooled JVM' infrastructure. There are a number of more recent IBM Redbooks publications covering the replacement 'JVM server' technology, including:

IBM CICS and the JVM server: Developing and Deploying Java Applications, SG24-8038

A Software Architect’s guide to New Java Workloads in IBM CICS Transaction Server, SG24-8225[

title: Destination Facilitation: A Travel Guide to Training Around the World
description:
Your Global Training Adventure AwaitsThe world may seem to be getting smaller and more familiar, but that doesn’t mean the same instructional techniques or training styles work everywhere. Organizations worldwide need talent development professionals who can design and deliver learning content that meets the needs of diverse workforces.

Destination Facilitation is rich in tips for creating incredible training experiences around the globe. This book brings together a team of 16 expert trainers to share their knowledge and wisdom on productive training results, whether you’re in Abuja or Zurich. These explorers present the best techniques for needs assessments, design processes, facilitation, and classroom management in whatever country or region you’re visiting.

Contributors include Matthew Axvig, David Brown, Alfredo Castro, Dan DeRoche, Bahaa Hussein, Fady Kreidy, Chan Lee, Claudia Salazar, Deniz Senelt Kalelioglu, David Smith, Donna Steffey, Marby Tabungar, Hamza Taqi, Kedar Vashi, Denise Walker, and David Xue.

Get to know your audience and master body language dos and don’ts. Plan for the logistics and technology constraints of training abroad. And avoid the cultural mistakes that interfere with learning transfer.

When the opportunity to design and deliver training in another country arises, don’t miss out. With Destination Facilitation, you’ll be prepared to say yes!

Este libro reúne a un equipo de 16 instructores expertos para compartir su conocimiento y sabiduría sobre resultados productivos de entrenamiento, ya sea en Abuja o en Zurich. Estos exploradores presentan las mejores técnicas para evaluaciones de necesidades, procesos de diseño, facilitación y gestión de aulas en cualquier país o región que visite.

Los colaboradores incluyen a Matthew Axvig, David Brown, Alfredo Castro, Dan DeRoche, Bahaaa Hussein, Fady Kreidy, Chan Lee, Claudia Salazar, Deniz Senelt Kalelioglu, David Smith, Donna Steffey, Marby Tabungar, Hamza Taqi, Kedar Vashi, Denise Walker y David Xue.

Conozca a su audiencia y master body language dos y no. Plan para las limitaciones logísticas y tecnológicas de la capacitación en el extranjero. Evite los errores culturales que interfieren con la transferencia de aprendizaje.

Cuando surge la oportunidad de diseñar y ofrecer entrenamiento en otro país, no te pierdas. Con la Facilitación del Destino, usted estará preparado para decir sí!

title: Tomcat 6 Developer's Guide
description:
The "Tomcat 6 Developer's Guide" takes you on an in-depth journey into the Apache Tomcat servlet container. With this book, you'll gain a detailed understanding of how Tomcat implements the Java Servlet specification, empowering you to harness its full potential in your Java EE web applications.

What this Book will help me do

Gain an in-depth understanding of the entire Apache Tomcat architecture and its components.
Learn to build a custom Tomcat distribution from source code using tools like Eclipse and Ant.
Understand servlet container workings including configuration, request processing, and resource management.
Explore advanced topics like custom class loaders, custom protocol handling, and JNDI-based services.
Master critical optimization and design techniques for building scalable and high-performance systems.

Author(s)

The authors, seasoned software architects and Java EE experts, bring years of experience in designing and programming high-performance server-side systems. Known for their practical, hands-on teaching approach, they make complex topics accessible and straightforward.

Who is it for?

This book is ideal for web developers looking to elevate their skills to an expert level by delving deeper into Tomcat and servlet containers. It's also valuable for system administrators tasked with managing Tomcat deployments and developers interested in contributing to the Tomcat project. A basic understanding of Java and web development is recommended.
translatedDescription:
El "Tomcat 6 Developer's Guide" te lleva a un viaje en profundidad hacia el contenedor de servlet Apache Tomcat. Con este libro, obtendrás una comprensión detallada de cómo Tomcat implementa la especificación Java Servlet, facultándote para aprovechar todo su potencial en tus aplicaciones web Java EE.

Lo que este libro me ayudará a hacer

Obtenga una comprensión profunda de toda la arquitectura Apache Tomcat y sus componentes.
Aprende a construir una distribución personalizada de Tomcat desde el código fuente usando herramientas como Eclipse y Ant.
Comprender los trabajos de contenedores servlet incluyendo configuración, procesamiento de solicitudes y gestión de recursos.
Explore temas avanzados como cargadores de clase personalizados, manejo de protocolos personalizados y servicios basados en JNDI.
Técnicas de optimización crítica y diseño para la construcción de sistemas escalables y de alto rendimiento.

Autor(s)

Los autores, arquitectos de software experimentados y expertos de Java EE, aportan años de experiencia en diseño y programación de sistemas de servidor de alto rendimiento. Conocido por su enfoque práctico y práctico de la enseñanza, hacen que los temas complejos sean accesibles y directos.

¿Para quién es?

Este libro es ideal para desarrolladores web que buscan elevar sus habilidades a un nivel experto al profundizar en los contenedores Tomcat y servlet. También es valioso para los administradores del sistema encargados de gestionar implementaciones y desarrolladores de Tomcat interesados en contribuir al proyecto Tomcat. Se recomienda una comprensión básica de Java y desarrollo web.

title: Braiding Technology for Textiles
description:
Braided fabrics are made by interlacing yarns or strips of fabric. Braiding produces a wide range of structures for technical textile applications from medical sutures to cables for anchoring ships. Written by one of the world’s leading experts in the field, the book reviews the basic principles, design and processes used in braiding. The book also discusses specialised braiding techniques such as spiral braiding and lace technology.
Provides a solid foundation in the fundamentals of braiding design, processes and machinery
Covers the patterning of braided products and the structural and colour design of both flat and tubular braids
Reviews maypole braiding machines and mechanics
translatedDescription:
Los tejidos trenzados están hechos por hilos entrelazados o tiras de tela. El trenzado produce una amplia gama de estructuras para aplicaciones textiles técnicas de suturas médicas a cables para anclajes. Escrito por uno de los principales expertos del mundo en el campo, el libro revisa los principios básicos, diseño y procesos utilizados en el trenzado. El libro también habla de técnicas especializadas de trenzado, como el trenzado espiral y la tecnología de encaje.
Proporciona una base sólida en los fundamentos del diseño, los procesos y la maquinaria de trenzado
Cubre el patrón de productos trenzados y el diseño estructural y de color tanto de trenzas planas como tubulares
Reseñas máquinas de fresado maypole y mecánica

title: Residential Broadband, Second Edition
description:
A comprehensive introduction to high-speed residential networks, integrating technical, business, and regulartory challenges.

Readers will learn about the services that are driving the market, the technical issues shaping the evolution, and the network within the home and how it connects to the access network. description:
The Holiday Makers is thought-provoking and profound in its analysis of the present and future patterns of work and leisure.

The author analyses the different forms of tourism, examines the effects on the indigenous countries and their people, and outlines positive steps to reconcile people's holiday requirements with the world's economic and social structures.

title: Overtourism
description:
Overtourism has become a major concern for an increasing number of destinations as tourism numbers continue to grow, stimulated by general economic and technological growth and the expansion of the global middle class. This, coupled with relentless promotion of tourism by many organisations and destinations, has increased tourism, despite growing opposition to excessive development. This book is the first academic volume to deal with this topic and contains chapters by experienced researchers in the tourism field, taking a multidisciplinary approach to review and explain the subject. The introductory section begins with an overview of the current situation and the forces enabling the appearance of overtourism. This is followed by a number of case studies from a range of destinations around the world, both urban and rural, which share the same problems. The concluding section includes a discussion of potential mitigation methods and approaches and a final assessment of future developments.

The focus and relevance of this book are not just for academics, as it offers insights into destinations, enablers and solutions for how to address the issue of overtourism on a wide variety of scales. This book offers globally relevant perspectives on destinations as varied as Venice and Barcelona, that have gained global media attention, as well as less publicised rural areas and developing destinations.
translatedDescription:
El sobreturismo se ha convertido en una preocupación importante por un número creciente de destinos a medida que el número de turismo continúa creciendo, estimulado por el crecimiento económico y tecnológico general y la expansión de la clase media mundial. Esto, junto con la promoción implacable del turismo por muchas organizaciones y destinos, ha aumentado el turismo, a pesar de la creciente oposición al desarrollo excesivo. Este libro es el primer volumen académico para tratar este tema y contiene capítulos de investigadores experimentados en el campo del turismo, tomando un enfoque multidisciplinario para revisar y explicar el tema. La sección introductoria comienza con una visión general de la situación actual y las fuerzas que permiten la aparición del sobreturismo. Esto es seguido por varios estudios de casos de diversos destinos del mundo, tanto urbanos como rurales, que comparten los mismos problemas. La sección final incluye un debate sobre posibles métodos y enfoques de mitigación y una evaluación final de los acontecimientos futuros.

El enfoque y la relevancia de este libro no son sólo para los académicos, ya que ofrece información sobre los destinos, habilitadores y soluciones para cómo abordar la cuestión del sobreturismo en una amplia variedad de escalas. Este libro ofrece perspectivas globalmente relevantes sobre destinos tan variados como Venecia y Barcelona, que han ganado la atención mediática global, así como áreas rurales menos publicadas y destinos en desarrollo.

title: Critical Theories in Dark Tourism
description:
This book facilitates a critical investigation of gaps in theorizing and framing dark tourism by navigating through some onto-epistemological issues, theoretical entanglements, future possibilities, and the application of critical theoretical perspectives related to affect and emotions, human-animal studies, postcolonialism, feminism, trauma studies, posthumanism, power and identity. In doing so, it advances the need to connect critical theory, pragmatism and contemporary issues of social and global relevance.

"Given the growing body of critical research within tourism studies, dark tourism has somewhat lagged behind. For example, critical tourism researchers have been examining postcolonialism for two decades, but dark tourism research has only sporadically engaged with this topic. Similarly, the issue of gender has been curiously neglected within dark tourism. In addition, dark tourism research has tended to shy away from the ‘big’ challenges facing contemporary societies. Through its engagement with a range of critical theories, this volume not only addresses gaps in the existing dark tourism literature but also moves the debate forward in exciting new directions. This volume is well-placed to demonstrate to other disciplines and fields that dark tourism research can be critical, theoretically grounded, and transformative." – Duncan Light
translatedDescription:
Este libro facilita una investigación crítica de las lagunas en la teorización y enmarcación del turismo oscuro navegando a través de algunos temas ontoepistemológicos, enredos teóricos, posibilidades futuras, y la aplicación de perspectivas teóricas críticas relacionadas con el afecto y las emociones, estudios humanos-animales, postcolonialismo, feminismo, estudios de trauma, posthumanismo, poder e identidad. Al hacerlo, avanza la necesidad de conectar la teoría crítica, el pragmatismo y las cuestiones contemporáneas de relevancia social y mundial.

"Dado el creciente cuerpo de investigación crítica dentro de los estudios turísticos, el turismo oscuro se ha quedado un poco atrasado. Por ejemplo, investigadores del turismo crítico han estado examinando el postcolonialismo durante dos décadas, pero la investigación turística oscura sólo ha estado comprometida esporádicamente con este tema. Del mismo modo, la cuestión del género se ha descuidado con curiosidad dentro del turismo oscuro. Además, la investigación turística oscura ha tendido a alejarse de los grandes desafíos que enfrentan las sociedades contemporáneas. A través de su compromiso con una serie de teorías críticas, este volumen no sólo aborda las lagunas en la literatura turística oscura existente, sino que también mueve el debate hacia adelante en nuevas direcciones emocionantes. Este volumen está bien situado para demostrar a otras disciplinas y campos que la investigación turística oscura puede ser crítica, teóricamente basada y transformadora." – Duncan Light

title: Scripted Journeys
description:
The ubiquity of computation in daily life has had decisive influence on the imaginative aspects of tourism. Online knowledge of the world is readily available through mapping services, social media, travel blogs, and online reviews. From booking and Googling, to posting and reminiscing: all stages of one’s trip can be guided and augmented by increasingly connective, personalized, and optimized algorithmic systems.

In the face of this informational abundance, hypermediated tourism is fixated on access to authenticity. Peer to peer accommodation offers tourists a chance to "live like a local." Professional bloggers instruct not just on where, but on how to travel. Review websites aggregate the feedback of millions into "objective," data-driven authentication of destinations. And virtual technologies take users to places they could not dream of reaching physically.

Based on a comparative ethnography of touristic blogs and vlogs, review websites, and video game environments, Scripted Journeys presents a critical analysis of touristic practice in digital ecologies. This hypermediated tourism engages technology as a harbinger of self-possession and waywardness, yet produces its own forms of digital dependence. The resulting "scripted journeys" internalize a tension between authenticity as autonomy and control, and the implicit compliance of making use of technological extensions.
translatedDescription:
La ubicuidad de la computación en la vida cotidiana ha tenido una influencia decisiva en los aspectos imaginativos del turismo. El conocimiento en línea del mundo está disponible fácilmente a través de servicios de mapeo, redes sociales, blogs de viaje y reseñas en línea. Desde la reserva y Googling, hasta la publicación y rememoración: todas las etapas del viaje pueden ser guiadas y aumentadas por sistemas de algoritmos cada vez más conectados, personalizados y optimizados.

Ante esta abundancia informativa, el turismo hipermediado se fija en el acceso a la autenticidad. Peer to peer accommodation ofrece a los turistas la oportunidad de "vivir como un local". Los bloggers profesionales instruyen no sólo en dónde, sino en cómo viajar. Los sitios web de revisión agregan la retroalimentación de millones en la autenticación "objetiva", basada en datos de los destinos. Y las tecnologías virtuales llevan a los usuarios a lugares que no podían soñar con llegar físicamente.

Basado en una etnografía comparativa de blogs turísticos y vlogs, sitios web de revisión y entornos de videojuegos, Scripted Journeys presenta un análisis crítico de la práctica turística en ecologies digitales. Este turismo hipermediado involucra la tecnología como un harbinger de la auto-possesión y el camino, pero produce sus propias formas de dependencia digital. Los "viajes reclutados" resultantes internalizan una tensión entre la autenticidad como autonomía y control, y el cumplimiento implícito de hacer uso de extensiones tecnológicas.

title: How Wealth Rules the World
description: Crackdowns on local democracy are accelerating, as corporate and state interests continue efforts to repress social movements. In this well-timed book, Ben Price presciently reveals structures of power and law that facilitate blatant corporate supremacy in the United States. Price uses his years of experience as a community organizer and a careful reading of history to show how a legal paradigm that facilitated slavery and the fossil fuel economy has endured and adapted over time – today barricading our communities and squelching dissent.Many books have been written about wealth, power and politics in the United States. Most of them make intuitive sense. Wealthy people use their power to influence and control politics. But Ben Price's new book is often counterintuitive as he explores how wealth itself is imbued with power. He answers questions such as:How is the American Legislative Exchange Council – a modern states' rights, free market capitalist group – the intellectual and political descendant of George Washington's Federalist Party?How was the Fourteenth Amendment that emancipated African American slaves from their status as property used by a reactionary Supreme Court to grant legal “personhood” to private corporations?How are cities seen under our legal doctrine as “public corporations,” devoid of real governing authority?Further, Price identifies key counterrevolutions in U.S. history that squelched the transformative potential of the Civil War and American Revolution, and traces the roots of colonial and imperial systems of control. He links them to modern “free trade” agreements and other antidemocratic structures used to supersede democracy to this day.For some, this will come as no surprise. For others, it will be a rude, though necessary, awakening. “The white man's municipalities are just reservations, like ours,” said a resident of Pine Ridge Reservation, who Price spoke with. "The difference is, we know we live on reservations. The white man doesn't.”Crucially, Price shares insight into how social movements can plant seeds of a new legal system that makes the liberty, civil rights and dignity of humans and ecosystems its ultimate purpose. In fact, he introduces the reader to people who are doing just that.
translatedDescription: Las crisis de la democracia local se están acelerando, ya que los intereses corporativos y estatales continúan los esfuerzos por reprimir los movimientos sociales. En este libro bien predefinido, Ben Price revela de antemano estructuras de poder y ley que facilitan la supremacía corporativa flagrante en los Estados Unidos. Price utiliza sus años de experiencia como organizador de la comunidad y una lectura cuidadosa de la historia para mostrar cómo un paradigma legal que facilitó la esclavitud y la economía de combustibles fósiles ha sufrido y adaptado a lo largo del tiempo – hoy barricando a nuestras comunidades y disenso asolador. Muchos libros se han escrito sobre la riqueza, el poder y la política en los Estados Unidos. La mayoría tiene sentido intuitivo. Las personas sanas usan su poder para influir y controlar la política. Pero el nuevo libro de Ben Price es a menudo contraintuitivo mientras explora cómo la riqueza en sí misma está impregnada de poder. Responde a preguntas como:¿Cómo está el Consejo Americano de Intercambio Legislativo –derechos de los Estados modernos, grupo capitalista de libre mercado – el descendiente intelectual y político del Partido Federalista de George Washington? ¿Cómo fue la 14a Enmienda que emancipó a los esclavos afroamericanos de su estatus como propiedad utilizada por un Tribunal Supremo reaccionario para otorgar “persona” legal a las corporaciones privadas? ¿Cómo se ven las ciudades bajo nuestra doctrina legal como “empresas públicas”, carentes de verdadera autoridad de gobierno? Además, Price identifica contrarrevoluciones claves en la historia de Estados Unidos que asolaron el potencial transformador de la Guerra Civil y la Revolución Americana, y traza las raíces de los sistemas de control coloniales e imperiales. Los vincula a acuerdos modernos de “libre comercio” y otras estructuras antidemocráticas utilizadas para superar la democracia hasta hoy. Para algunos, esto no será una sorpresa. Para otros, será una grosería, aunque sea necesario, despertar. “Los municipios del hombre blanco son sólo reservas, como las nuestras”, dijo un residente de Pine Ridge Reserva, con quien Price habló. "La diferencia es que sabemos que vivimos en reservas. El hombre blanco no. “Crucialmente, Price comparte información sobre cómo los movimientos sociales pueden plantar semillas de un nuevo sistema legal que hace de la libertad, los derechos civiles y la dignidad de los seres humanos y los ecosistemas su objetivo final. De hecho, presenta al lector a personas que están haciendo justo eso.

title: Secrets of the PlayStation Portable
description: With over 13 million shipped, the Sony PlayStation Portable, or PSP, is one of the fastest selling game consoles in history. In this essential guide, gaming expert Joel Durham, Jr. shows readers how to get the most out of this revolutionary handheld game console. After an initial tour around the interface, Joel will introduce the readers to the multimedia possibilities of the PSP, including gaming, movie playback, organizing and playing music, organizing and displaying photographs, and web surfing and RSS. In addition he will walk readers through how to use the device on a network, how to get the most life from the battery, how to pick a headset, how to set up a WLAN and more.
translatedDescription: Con más de 13 millones de envíos, Sony PlayStation Portable o PSP, es una de las consolas de juego más rápidas de la historia. En esta guía esencial, el experto en juegos Joel Durham, Jr. muestra a los lectores cómo sacar el máximo provecho de esta consola de juego de mano revolucionaria. Después de una gira inicial alrededor de la interfaz, Joel presentará a los lectores a las posibilidades multimedia del PSP, incluyendo el juego, la reproducción de películas, la organización y el juego de música, la organización y visualización de fotografías, y el surf web y RSS. Además, caminará a los lectores a través de cómo utilizar el dispositivo en una red, cómo obtener la mayor vida de la batería, cómo recoger un auricular, cómo configurar un WLAN y más.

title: Technology Business Incubators in India
description:
Why do Technology Business Incubators (TBIs) emerge rapidly as an instrument of start-up promotion in emerging economies like India? In what forms? What role do they play in start-up promotion? What are their major achievements? These questions have been answered empirically in this book. Accordingly, this book explores the nature, structure and process of incubation resulting in start-up generation and in the process, R&D contribution emerging from TBIs comprising accelerators, incubators and co-working spaces in three of the leading start-up hubs, namely, Bangalore, Chennai and Hyderabad, in India. It describes typology, objectives, sponsors, and facilities provided by these TBIs. It further explores the process of selection, incubation and graduation of start-ups as it exists in these TBIs. Thereafter, it makes an assessment of R&D contributions that have emerged from the TBIs in the form of R&D inputs comprising personnel and capital expenditure, and R&D output in the form of new products/services developed, patent applications filed and revenue generated.

Policy makers, researchers, engineering and management students, technology and business mentors, angels, venture capitalists, and MNC executives will find this book informative, revealing and a source of valuable insights on the new, emerging India.
translatedDescription:
¿Por qué surgen rápidamente las incubadoras de empresas tecnológicas (TBIs) como instrumento de promoción inicial en economías emergentes como India? ¿En qué formas? ¿Qué papel juegan en la promoción inicial? ¿Cuáles son sus principales logros? Estas preguntas han sido respondidas empíricamente en este libro. En consecuencia, este libro explora la naturaleza, la estructura y el proceso de incubación que da lugar a la generación inicial y en el proceso, la contribución de R plagaD proveniente de TBIs que comprende aceleradores, incubadoras y espacios de coworking en tres de los principales centros de puesta en marcha, a saber, Bangalore, Chennai y Hyderabad, en la India. Describe tipología, objetivos, patrocinadores e instalaciones proporcionadas por estos TBIs. También explora el proceso de selección, incubación y graduación de start-ups como existe en estos TBIs. En lo sucesivo, hace una evaluación de las contribuciones de los ITS que han surgido de los ITS en forma de insumos de I+D que comprenden el gasto de personal y capital, y la producción de I+D en forma de nuevos productos/servicios desarrollados, solicitudes de patentes presentadas e ingresos generados.

Formuladores de políticas, investigadores, estudiantes de ingeniería y gestión, mentores de tecnología y negocios, ángeles, capitalistas de riesgo y ejecutivos del MNC encontrarán este libro informativo, revelador y una fuente de valiosas ideas sobre la nueva India emergente.

title: The New Communications Technologies, 5th Edition
description:
As new communications applications are developed and brought to market, it is vital for communications professionals to keep abreast of these issues. Since the technologies and applications also affect our daily lives, it is important to understand how they will shape the country and, by extension, the world at large. International censorship, the impact of the Internet and wireless tools, and th legisation following the World Trade Center bombing all fall into this category.

The New Communications Technologies, Fifth Edition, provides vital information on the new and emerging technologies that will shape the way communicators do business. The book explores the new communications technologies and covers topics ranging from multimedia and production to satellites to digital communication. Just as important, the book examines the social, economic, and political impact brought about by the adoption of such technologies and applications; this fallout includes privacy concerns, First Amendment issues, and the implications raised by biometric systems.

A medida que se desarrollan y comercializan nuevas aplicaciones de comunicaciones, es fundamental que los profesionales de las comunicaciones se mantengan al corriente de estas cuestiones. Dado que las tecnologías y aplicaciones también afectan nuestra vida cotidiana, es importante entender cómo formarán el país y, por extensión, el mundo en general. La censura internacional, el impacto de Internet y las herramientas inalámbricas, y la legización tras el bombardeo del World Trade Center caen en esta categoría.

La Nueva Tecnología de las Comunicaciones, Quinta Edición, proporciona información vital sobre las nuevas y emergentes tecnologías que darán forma a la forma en que los comunicadores hacen negocios. El libro explora las nuevas tecnologías de las comunicaciones y abarca temas que van desde multimedia y producción hasta satélites a comunicación digital. Así como importante, el libro examina los impactos sociales, económicos y políticos generados por la adopción de tales tecnologías y aplicaciones; esta caída incluye preocupaciones de privacidad, cuestiones de Primera Enmienda, y las implicaciones planteadas por los sistemas biométricos.

title: Next Level Virtual Training: Advance Your Facilitation
description:
Surpass the Basics of Virtual Training

As virtual training continues as a go-to, effective learning option, and platform providers improve functionality, trainers and facilitators need to take their skills to the next level. Written by expert facilitator Diana L. Howles, this book goes beyond the basics of virtual training and online synchronous instruction, providing in-depth insights into advanced challenges.

Next Level Virtual Training introduces the Virtual Trainer Capability Model, which identifies eight areas of expertise for the top virtual professional. A train-the-virtual-trainer resource, this book will guide you in developing the specific knowledge and skills to facilitate online interactivity, manage multitasking, be technically fluent, oversee logistics and troubleshooting, leverage your voice, and engage virtual learners. Importantly, this book is about actionable tips, strategies, and techniques rather than the technologies.

Inside you’ll find comprehensive chapters on developing on-camera competence; applying learning experience design to live online learning; and preparing for the combination of onsite and online learners together in a post-pandemic hybrid work environment.

Whether you are a virtual trainer, a live online facilitator, a synchronous educator, an online adult education instructor, this book is for you. It is also for designers, developers, evaluators, and producers of virtual learning.
translatedDescription:
Supervisa los fundamentos de la formación virtual

A medida que la capacitación virtual continúa como una opción de aprendizaje eficaz, y los proveedores de plataformas mejoran la funcionalidad, los instructores y facilitadores necesitan llevar sus habilidades al siguiente nivel. Escrito por experta facilitadora Diana L. Howles, este libro va más allá de los fundamentos de la formación virtual y la instrucción sincronizada en línea, proporcionando información detallada sobre los desafíos avanzados.

Next Level Virtual Training presenta el Modelo de Capacidad de Entrenador Virtual, que identifica ocho áreas de experiencia para el mejor profesional virtual. Este libro te guiará en el desarrollo de conocimientos y habilidades específicos para facilitar la interactividad en línea, gestionar el multitarea, ser técnicamente fluidos, supervisar la logística y la solución de problemas, aprovechar tu voz y atraer a estudiantes virtuales. Importantemente, este libro trata de consejos, estrategias y técnicas factibles en lugar de las tecnologías.

Dentro encontrará capítulos completos sobre el desarrollo de la competencia en cámara; la aplicación de la experiencia de aprendizaje para vivir el aprendizaje en línea; y la preparación para la combinación de estudiantes in situ y en línea juntos en un ambiente de trabajo híbrido post-pandemia.

Ya sea que usted es un entrenador virtual, un facilitador en línea en vivo, un educador sincronizado, un instructor de educación para adultos en línea, este libro es para usted. También es para diseñadores, desarrolladores, evaluadores y productores de aprendizaje virtual.

title: Getting Started with Varnish Cache
description: How long does it take for your website to load? Web performance is just as critical for small and medium-sized websites as it is for massive websites that receive tons of hits. Before you pour money and time into rewriting your code or replacing your infrastructure, first consider a reverse-caching proxy server like Varnish. With this practical book, you’ll learn how Varnish can give your website or API an immediate performance boost.

title: VMware vSphere 5.5 Essentials
description:
This book provides an in-depth introduction to VMware vSphere 5.5, focusing on the tools and best practices for effectively virtualizing and managing IT infrastructures. You'll gain hands-on knowledge about creating virtual machines, configuring networks and storage, and using advanced features like vMotion, vSAN, and VMware NSX.

What this Book will help me do

Understand the architecture and components of VMware vSphere 5.5, including ESXi and vCenter Server.
Learn to create, manage, and optimize virtual machines efficiently.
Master the concepts of virtual networking using vNetwork Switches and VMware NSX.
Implement shared storage solutions and explore capabilities like vSAN and fault tolerance.
Delve into essential management techniques, such as updating, performance monitoring, and securing your vSphere environment.

Author(s)

N. Kumar and N. Stankowic are experienced system virtualization specialists with years of professional expertise in deploying and managing VMware vSphere environments. They bring a clear and concise teaching style to this book, aiming to make virtualization accessible to IT professionals.

Who is it for?

This book is designed for IT professionals and system administrators looking to expand their knowledge of VMware vSphere 5.5 and related virtualization technologies. If you are responsible for managing IT infrastructures, have a basic understanding of virtualization but want to master vSphere concepts, this is the book for you. No prior deep expertise is required, but familiarity with virtualized environments will be beneficial. Perfect for professionals aiming to enhance their virtualization skills and improve IT infrastructure efficiency.

Ganarás conocimientos prácticos sobre la creación de máquinas virtuales, la configuración de redes y almacenamiento, y el uso de funciones avanzadas como vMotion, vSAN y VMware NSX.

Entender la arquitectura y los componentes de VMware vSphere 5.5, incluyendo ESXi y vCenter Server.
Aprende a crear, gestionar y optimizar máquinas virtuales de manera eficiente.
Domine los conceptos de redes virtuales utilizando conmutadores vNetwork y VMware NSX.

Este libro está diseñado para profesionales de TI y administradores de sistemas que buscan ampliar su conocimiento de VMware vSphere 5.5 y tecnologías de virtualización relacionadas. No se requiere experiencia profunda previa, pero la familiaridad con entornos virtualizados será beneficiosa. Perfecto para profesionales que buscan mejorar sus habilidades de virtualización y mejorar la eficiencia de la infraestructura de TI.

title: Software and System Development using Virtual Platforms
description:
Virtual platforms are finding widespread use in both pre- and post-silicon computer software and system development. They reduce time to market, improve system quality, make development more efficient, and enable truly concurrent hardware/software design and bring-up. Virtual platforms increase productivity with unparalleled inspection, configuration, and injection capabilities. In combination with other types of simulators, they provide full-system simulations where computer systems can be tested together with the environment in which they operate.

This book is not only about what simulation is and why it is important, it will also cover the methods of building and using simulators for computer-based systems. Inside you’ll find a comprehensive book about simulation best practice and design patterns, using Simics as its base along with real-life examples to get the most out of your Simics implementation. You’ll learn about: Simics architecture, model-driven development, virtual platform modelling, networking, contiguous integration, debugging, reverse execution, simulator integration, workflow optimization, tool automation, and much more.

Distills decades of experience in using and building virtual platforms to help readers realize the full potential of virtual platform simulation
Covers modeling related use-cases including devices, systems, extensions, and fault injection
Explains how simulations can influence software development, debugging, system configuration, networking, and more
Discusses how to build complete full-system simulation systems from a mix of simulators

Las plataformas virtuales están encontrando un uso generalizado tanto en el software informático pre y post-silicon como en el desarrollo del sistema. Reducen el tiempo al mercado, mejoran la calidad del sistema, hacen que el desarrollo sea más eficiente, y permiten un diseño y un acercamiento de hardware/software verdaderamente simultáneos. Las plataformas virtuales aumentan la productividad con capacidades de inspección, configuración e inyección sin igual. En combinación con otros tipos de simuladores, proporcionan simulaciones de sistema completo donde los sistemas informáticos pueden ser probados junto con el entorno en el que operan.

Este libro no es sólo sobre qué simulación es y por qué es importante, también cubrirá los métodos de construcción y uso de simuladores para sistemas basados en ordenador. Dentro encontrará un libro completo sobre los mejores patrones de práctica y diseño de simulación, utilizando Simics como base junto con ejemplos de vida real para sacar el máximo provecho de su implementación Simics. Aprenderás sobre: Arquitectura Simics, desarrollo basado en modelos, modelado de plataforma virtual, creación de redes, integración contigua, depuración, ejecución inversa, integración de simuladores, optimización del flujo de trabajo, automatización de herramientas y mucho más.

Destiliza décadas de experiencia en el uso y construcción de plataformas virtuales para ayudar a los lectores a realizar todo el potencial de simulación de plataforma virtual
Cubre las maletas de uso relacionadas, incluyendo dispositivos, sistemas, extensiones e inyección de fallas
Explica cómo las simulaciones pueden influir en el desarrollo del software, la depuración, la configuración del sistema, las redes y más
Discusses how to build complete full-system simulation systems from a mix of simulators

title: Cardboard VR Projects for Android
